data: You get your adrenaline pumping and go into a frenzy. While worked up, you add +2 to all attack rolls. Your worked up status ends if you are incapacitated or if your turn ends and you have not attacked a hostile target since your last turn, or taken any damage since then.
Excites the audience a lot if used first.
Raises the crowd meter by 2 if successfully performed first in correct contest, raises the crowd meter by 1 if successfully performed first in complementary contest.
